Extract the payment details from the following bill file contents. I need: the IBAN of the recipient (the account the money must be paid to), the total amount to be paid (as a number), and a short subject/description for the payment (e.g. the bill name and period). For the date, return the payment date or due date written in the bill in the format YYYY-MM-DD. If no date is present in the bill, return an empty string for the date. Bill contents:
